DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込依頼書をお預かりします。受取人のお名前の欄が空いていますが、お分かりでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll take your transfer request form. The recipient's name field is blank. Do you know the name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 請求書には店の名前しか書いていません。口座の名義も同じか分からず、空けてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 請求書には店名しかなく口座名義が同じか分からないため欄を空けたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The invoice only shows the shop's name. I left it blank because I don't know whether the account is under the same name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the invoice only has the shop name and you left the field blank because you do not know whether the account name is the same. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 振込先の銀行名、支店名、口座番号は記載されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does it list the recipient's bank, branch, and account number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: その三つはあります。こちらの請求書ですが、店名の下に株式会社という文字もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 銀行名と支店名と口座番号があり、店名の下に株式会社の表記もあると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It has all three. Here is the invoice; below the shop name it also says “joint-stock company.”
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that the bank, branch, and account number are listed and that there is also a joint-stock company designation below the shop name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表記だけで名義を決めず、相手先に口座名義を確認しましょう。連絡できる電話番号はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Rather than deciding the account name from that wording alone, let's confirm it with the recipient. Do you have a telephone number you can call?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 担当者の番号があります。今ここで電話して、振込用の名義をカタカナで教えてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 担当者へ電話し振込用の口座名義をカタカナで聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the contact person's number. I'll call here now and ask them for the transfer account name in katakana.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will telephone the contact person and ask for the transfer account name in katakana. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。電話がつながらなければ、未記入のままお預かりして振り込むことはできませんので、確認後にお手続きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. If you cannot reach them, we cannot accept the form and make the transfer with that field blank, so please complete the procedure after confirming it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日中の振込を頼まれていますが、間に合わない場合は、相手に相談した方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日中の振込を求められているが間に合わなければ相手先へ相談すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've been asked to make the transfer today, but if I won't make it in time, I should discuss that with the recipient, shouldn't I?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that although you were asked to transfer today, you will consult the recipient if you cannot make it in time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付時間や入金時期も手続きによって異なります。名義が確認できたら、この窓口で合わせて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Acceptance hours and when the money arrives also vary with the procedure. Once you know the account name, let's check those together at this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。まず相手に名義を聞いて、今日の受付に間に合うかも確認してから依頼書を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相手先の名義と当日の受付可否を確認してから振込依頼書を提出すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll first ask the recipient for the account name, then check whether I can still submit it today before handing in the request form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will confirm the recipient's account name and whether today's submission is possible before submitting the transfer request form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ご確認をお願いします。手続きの際はお声をおかけください。お帰りもどうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check those details. Let us know when you are ready for the procedure. Take care on your way home, too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 惣菜の棚で何かお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for something at the prepared-food shelves?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この弁当の値引きシールが途中で剥がれて、数字が読めません。いくらで買えるのか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 値引きシールの数字が読めない弁当の購入価格を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The discount sticker on this boxed meal has partly peeled off, so I can't read the number. I'd like to check how much I can buy it for.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to check the purchase price of a boxed meal whose discount sticker number is unreadable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 別の弁当のシールとは違うかもしれませんので、この商品の表示を調べます。どちらの棚から取りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: It may differ from the sticker on another boxed meal, so I'll check this item's label. Which shelf did you take it from?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一番下の棚の右端です。同じ弁当にもシールがありましたが、そちらの数字は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一番下の棚の右端から取ったことと他のシールの数字は見ていないことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The far right of the bottom shelf. The same boxed meals also had stickers, but I didn't look at their numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you took it from the far right of the bottom shelf and did not look at the numbers on other stickers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所が分かりました。売場の担当に確認します。貼り替えるまでは、剥がれたシールをそのままにしておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I know the location now. I'll check with the sales-floor staff. Please leave the peeling sticker as it is until we replace it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、触らずに待ちます。値引き後の金額を見てから買うか決めてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: シールに触らず待ち、値引き後の金額を見て購入を決めてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I'll wait without touching it. May I decide whether to buy it after seeing the discounted price?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will wait without touching the sticker and ask whether you may decide to buy after seeing the discounted price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: もちろんです。確認できました。この商品は税込表示の五百円から二割引です。読めるシールに貼り替えますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Of course. I've confirmed it: this item is twenty percent off the displayed tax-inclusive price of five hundred yen. I'll replace it with a readable sticker.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 税込五百円の二割引なので、支払う金額は四百円ですね。今日の夕食に一つ買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 税込五百円の二割引が四百円であると確認し夕食用に一つ買うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Twenty percent off five hundred yen including tax means I pay four hundred yen, right? I'll buy one for tonight's dinner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that twenty percent off five hundred yen including tax is four hundred yen, and say you will buy one for dinner. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示の金額は四百円です。消費期限もこちらでご確認ください。保冷が必要でしたら袋を売場でお選びいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The displayed price is four hundred yen. Please check the use-by date here, too. If you need to keep it cold, you can choose an insulated bag on the sales floor.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 期限を確認しました。家が近いので保冷袋は買わず、この弁当をレジへ持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 期限を確認し家が近いため保冷袋は買わず弁当をレジへ持っていくと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the date. I live nearby, so I won't buy an insulated bag; I'll take this boxed meal to the checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you checked the date and, since you live nearby, will not buy an insulated bag but will take the boxed meal to the checkout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございます。シールを貼り替えましたので、こちらをどうぞ。お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. I've replaced the sticker, so here you are. Take care on your way home, too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 公園の利用についてのご相談ですね。どのような活動を予定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to discuss using the park. What sort of activity are you planning?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもたちと落ち葉の色を比べる活動をしたいです。地面の葉を少し集めてもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子どもと落ち葉の色を比べるため地面の葉を少し集めてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to compare fallen-leaf colors with the children. May we gather a few leaves from the ground?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may gather a few leaves from the ground to compare fallen-leaf colors with children. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 活動の人数と、集めた葉をどうする予定か教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me how many people will take part and what you plan to do with the collected leaves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 大人が二人、子どもが六人です。机の上で並べて見た後、葉をどこへ戻すか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大人二人と子ども六人で葉を並べた後の戻し先に迷っていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two adults and six children. After laying them out on a table to look at, we're unsure where to put the leaves back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that there will be two adults and six children and you are unsure where to return the leaves after laying them out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 採取や持ち出しの扱いを管理担当に確認します。清掃用の袋に入っている葉には触れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the collection and removal rules with the management staff. Please do not touch leaves in the cleaning bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 清掃の袋は使いません。まだ確認が取れていない間は、葉の写真を撮って比べる方法にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 清掃袋を使わず確認が済むまでは葉の写真を撮って比較すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: We won't use the cleaning bags. While we haven't received confirmation, we'll take photographs of the leaves and compare those instead.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not use the cleaning bags and will photograph and compare the leaves until confirmation is obtained. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真なら、他の利用者の顔が写らないよう配慮してください。活動は通路を塞がない場所でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you take photographs, please take care not to include other visitors' faces. Please hold the activity somewhere that does not block the path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通路から離れて行います。落ち葉が多い所へ子どもだけで行かせず、大人が付き添います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路から離れた場所で行い子どもに大人が付き添うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We'll do it away from the path. We won't send the children alone to places with many fallen leaves; an adult will accompany them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will do it away from the path and an adult will accompany the children. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その形でお願いします。葉を使えるかどうかと、使った後の扱いが分かったらお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do it that way. I'll let you know once we know whether you can use the leaves and how to handle them afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、連絡先を書きます。回答を受け取るまでは採らず、写真で観察する計画を参加者に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を書き回答までは採取せず写真で観察する計画を参加者へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll write down my contact details. I'll tell the participants that, until we get an answer, we won't collect leaves and will observe them through photographs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will write your contact details and tell participants the plan is to observe through photographs without collecting leaves until an answer arrives. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。回答後に活動内容を調整しましょう。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35212-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for cooperating. Let's adjust the activity after the answer comes. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 経路の画面をお持ちですね。どの部分が気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a route-search screen with you. Which part are you concerned about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人に会いに行くのですが、検索した便はもう出たようです。今からの経路を調べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 出発済みの便ではなく現在時刻からの経路を探したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm going to meet a friend, but the service I searched for seems to have already left. I'd like to find a route from now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want a route from the current time rather than a service that has already departed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 画面の出発日が昨日になっていますね。待ち合わせの時刻と、最後に降りる駅を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The departure date on the screen is yesterday. Please tell me your meeting time and your final station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日の午後三時に待ち合わせです。駅名はこのメッセージに書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今日の午後三時という条件とメッセージの駅名を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: We're meeting at three this afternoon. The station name is in this message.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the station name in the message and the condition of meeting at three this afternoon. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、今日の現在時刻で検索し直しましょう。検索上の到着時刻には、駅から待ち合わせ場所まで歩く時間は含まれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's search again using today's date and the current time. The arrival time in the search does not include walking from the station to your meeting place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 改札から十分ほど歩くそうなので、二時五十分までに駅に着く便を探せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 徒歩十分を見込み、二時五十分までに駅へ着きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Apparently it's about a ten-minute walk from the ticket gates. Can you find a service that gets to the station by two fifty?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Allow for a ten-minute walk and say you want to reach the station by two fifty. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その条件を入れて確認します。候補が出たら、乗り換えの回数と待ち時間も比べましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll enter those conditions and check. Once the options appear, let's compare the number of changes and waiting times, too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この候補は乗り換えが一回ですが、五分しかありません。別の候補も見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 五分の乗り換えを避け、別の候補も比較したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: This option has one change, but only five minutes for it. I'd like to see other options as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to avoid a five-minute connection and compare other options. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 短い乗り換えが不安なら、余裕のある候補から選びましょう。運行状況も確認してから決めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: If a short connection worries you, choose an option with more time. Check the current service information before deciding, too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 少し早く着くほうを選びます。友人にも、到着予定を送り直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 早めに着く候補を選び友人に到着予定を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll choose the one that arrives a little earlier. I'll send my friend an updated expected arrival time as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose an earlier-arriving option and tell your friend the expected arrival time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 予定が変わったときも連絡しておくと安心ですね。乗り場の表示を確かめて、お気をつけていってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: It helps to let them know if your plans change, too. Check the platform signs, and have a safe trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書の申請ですね。提出先から指定された名称はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are applying for a certificate. Has the receiving organization specified its name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 賃貸契約で住民票が必要です。ただ、私だけのものか、家族全員のものか書いてありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 賃貸契約の住民票について本人分か世帯全員分か不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need a resident record for a rental contract. But it doesn't say whether it should be just mine or for the whole family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you do not know whether the resident record for the rental contract should cover you alone or the entire household. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本人分か世帯全員分かは、提出先の指定によります。案内に記載項目の説明はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Whether it is for you alone or the whole household depends on the receiving organization's requirements. Does the guidance explain the details that must be included?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「住民票一通」とだけあります。必要以上の個人情報は載せたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一通という指定のみで不要な個人情報を省きたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It only says “one copy of a resident record.” I don't want to include more personal information than necessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that only one copy is specified and you want to omit unnecessary personal information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、申請前に不動産会社へ確認しましょう。対象となる人と、必要な記載項目を尋ねてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let's check with the real estate company before applying. Ask whose information is required and which details must be included.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話で聞く内容を忘れそうなので、その二点をメモしてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象者と記載項目の二点をメモしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I might forget what to ask on the telephone. May I write down those two points?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to note the two points: whose information and which details are required. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: もちろんです。発行日について条件があるかも、併せて確認すると取り直しを防げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Of course. Checking whether there is a condition concerning the issue date can also prevent having to obtain another copy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 本人分でよいか、記載項目と発行日の条件ですね。今、担当者に電話してみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象者、記載項目、発行日の条件を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: So, whether mine alone is enough, the required details, and the issue-date conditions. I'll call the contact person now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check the covered persons, required details, and issue-date conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認が済んだら、この窓口へ戻ってください。まだ申請書は提出せず、お手元に置いておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Come back to this counter once you have checked. Please keep the application form with you and do not submit it yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に電話で確かめます。回答が曖昧だったら、書面でもらえるか頼んでみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 先に電話し、曖昧なら書面の回答を求めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check by telephone first. If the answer is unclear, I'll ask whether I can have it in writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will call first and request a written answer if it is unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 指定がわかれば、申請書の該当欄をご案内できます。それでは、ご確認後にお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once we know the requirements, I can show you the relevant fields on the form. We'll be here when you return after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の手が止まっていますが、読みにくいところがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've stopped filling in the medical questionnaire. Is there something difficult to read?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「既往歴」という言葉がわかりません。今痛いところを書く欄ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 既往歴の意味と現在の痛みを書く欄かを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I don't understand “medical history.” Is that where I write about what hurts now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what medical history means and whether it is the field for current pain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: これまでにかかった病気などを書く欄です。今の症状は、こちらの欄にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is for illnesses and similar conditions you have had in the past. Please write your current symptoms in this field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 五年前に足首を骨折しました。今は左ひざが痛いので、別々に書くのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 五年前の足首骨折と現在の左ひざの痛みを別々に記入すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I broke my ankle five years ago. My left knee hurts now, so I should write those separately, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you should record the ankle fracture five years ago and the current left-knee pain separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。今回のひざの痛みは、いつ始まりましたか。思い当たるきっかけもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. When did this knee pain start? Can you think of anything that triggered it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日、荷物を運んだあとに気づきました。ひねったかどうかは覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昨日の荷物運搬後に気づき、ひねったかは不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I noticed it yesterday after carrying some things. I don't remember whether I twisted it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you noticed it after carrying things yesterday and do not know whether you twisted it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 覚えていない点はそのままお伝えください。どんな動きで痛むかも書けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please say exactly that for things you do not remember. Can you also write which movements cause pain?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 立ち上がるときに痛みます。歩いているときとは違う痛みなので、診察で説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 立ち上がる際の痛みと歩行時の違いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It hurts when I stand up. It feels different from when I'm walking, so I'd like to explain that during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the pain when standing up and its difference from pain while walking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その違いは医師に直接お伝えください。私からも、説明をゆっくりしてほしいことを伝えておきますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the doctor directly about that difference. Shall I also let them know you would like explanations given slowly?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。説明を聞いてわからない言葉があれば、その場で意味を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ゆっくりした説明を頼み、不明な用語は聞き返すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please. If there are words I don't understand in the explanation, I'll ask what they mean there and then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for slow explanations and say you will ask again about unfamiliar terms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 遠慮なく聞いてくださいね。記入が終わったらお預かりします。それでは、待合室でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please feel free to ask. I'll take the form when you've finished it. Then please wait in the waiting room.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談の内容を伺います。届いた連絡についてお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let me hear what you would like to discuss. Are you having trouble with a message you received?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 電話料金が未払いだというメッセージが来ました。でも、書かれた会社とは契約していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 契約のない会社から電話料金の未払い連絡が届いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I got a message saying my phone bill is unpaid. But I don't have a contract with the company it names.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you received an unpaid phone-bill notice from a company with which you have no contract. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: リンクを開いたり、相手に情報を送ったりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you opened the link or sent them any information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: リンクは開いていません。今日中に払わないと訴えると書かれていて、怖くなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: リンクは開かず、当日中の支払いと訴訟の文面が怖いと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't opened the link. It says they'll sue if I don't pay today, and that frightened me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you did not open the link and are frightened by the wording demanding payment today and threatening a lawsuit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 慌てて支払わず、まず内容を確認しましょう。届いた時刻や送信元がわかる画面は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Rather than rushing to pay, let's first check the contents. Do you still have a screen showing when it arrived and who sent it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 元のメッセージは残っています。本文だけ撮ったのですが、送信元も一緒に残したほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元の連絡と本文画像があり送信元も保存すべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I still have the original message. I only took a picture of the body; should I save the sender as well?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have the original message and an image of its body, and ask whether to save the sender too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、経緯がわかる記録を残してください。今、この相手が家に来ているなど、身近な危険はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, please retain a record showing what happened. Is there any immediate danger, such as that person being at your home now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家には誰も来ていません。ただ、契約していないと返信してよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 訪問者はいないが返信すべきか迷っていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No one has come to my home. But I'm unsure whether to reply that I have no contract with them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that no one has visited but you are unsure whether to reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今は返信せず、こちらで記録を確認させてください。必要な相談先や、追加で確認する点を整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please don't reply for now, and let us check the records here. We'll organize suitable places to consult and anything else that needs checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では返信せず、この画面を見せます。追加で届いた連絡も消さずに残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返信を控えて画面を見せ、追加の連絡も保存すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I won't reply, and I'll show you this screen. I'll keep any further messages without deleting them, too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will refrain from replying, show the screen, and save additional messages too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記録はこのまま相談担当者に引き継ぎます。相談室へご案内しますので、そちらで詳しくお話しください。それでは、こちらの窓口での受付は以上です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass these records directly to the adviser. I'll guide you to the consultation room, so please explain the details there. That completes reception at this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物をお預かりする前に、中身と送り先を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before accepting your parcel, could you tell me what is inside and where you are sending it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 国内の家族宛てです。本と冬服を詰めたのですが、持ち上げると箱の底がたわみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 国内の家族に本と冬服を送りたいが箱の底がたわむと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's for family within Japan. I've packed books and winter clothes, but the bottom of the box sags when I lift it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to send books and winter clothes to family in Japan, but the box bottom sags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 底が抜けるおそれがあるので、このままお預かりせず、梱包を見直しましょう。本は箱の中で動きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The bottom could give way, so rather than accepting it as it is, let's review the packing. Do the books move inside the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 服の上に置いていて、傾けると動きます。本を下にして隙間を埋めたほうがいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本が動くことを伝え、下に置いて隙間を埋める方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: They're on top of the clothes and move when I tilt it. Should I put the books underneath and fill the gaps?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the books move and ask about placing them underneath and filling the gaps. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 重い物を安定させ、中身が動かないようにしてください。箱自体が弱ければ、丈夫な箱への交換も必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please stabilize the heavy items and prevent the contents from moving. If the box itself is weak, you will also need to replace it with a sturdy one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この箱は何度か使っています。いったん家で丈夫な箱に詰め直してきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 使い古した箱を丈夫な箱へ交換すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've used this box several times. I'll go home and repack everything in a sturdy box, then bring it back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will replace the well-used box with a sturdy one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 詰め直すと大きさや重さが変わることがあります。料金は、発送する状態で測ってからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Repacking may change the size and weight. We'll quote the charge after measuring it in the condition in which you will send it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の箱で料金を決めるのではないのですね。送り方は、追跡できるものを希望します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発送状態で料金を決めると確認し、追跡できる方法を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: So you won't set the charge using the current box. I'd like a delivery method with tracking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the charge is determined in its ready-to-send condition and request a method with tracking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 追跡の希望も含めて、詰め直したお荷物で利用できる方法をご案内します。宛先はもう確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll explain the methods available for your repacked parcel, taking your request for tracking into account. Have you checked the address already?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族に住所を確認済みです。新しい箱には、その住所を写してからもう一度照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族確認済みの住所を新しい箱へ写し再照合すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've confirmed it with my family. I'll copy that address onto the new box and compare it again afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will copy the family-confirmed address onto the new box and check it again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 番地や部屋番号の写し間違いにもお気をつけください。それでは、梱包ができましたらお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Watch out for errors when copying the street and room numbers, too. Please bring it in when the packing is ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込の確認画面でお困りですか。まだ実行ボタンは押していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the transfer confirmation screen? You haven't pressed the execute button yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだ押していません。家賃の振込先を入れたら、受取人が請求書と違う名前になりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未実行で受取人名が請求書と違うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I haven't pressed it yet. After entering the rent payment destination, the recipient name appeared different from the invoice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have not executed the transfer and the recipient name differs from the invoice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのまま実行しないでください。銀行名や支店、口座番号は、請求書と一致していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not execute it as it is. Do the bank, branch, and account number match the invoice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号は同じに見えますが、支店を選び間違えたかもしれません。もう一度見比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号を照合し、支店の選択誤りを疑って再確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The number looks the same, but I may have selected the wrong branch. I'd like to compare them again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will compare the number and recheck because you suspect a wrong branch selection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 請求書を見ながら一つずつ確認しましょう。入力が正しくても名義が違う場合は、請求元への確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check each item against the invoice. If the name differs even with correct entries, you need to confirm it with the invoice issuer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入力を見直しても違うままです。管理会社に、口座名義が変わったのか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相違が残るため管理会社へ名義変更の有無を聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: It still differs after I recheck the entries. I'll ask the management company whether the account name has changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the difference remains, so you will ask the management company whether the account name changed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 以前から把握している管理会社の連絡先で確認してください。確認できるまでは振込を保留しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Use contact details for the management company that you already know. Let's hold off on the transfer until you can confirm it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 契約書にある電話番号へかけます。いったん取り消すと、今の入力内容は残らないのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 契約書の番号へ電話し、取消後に入力が残るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll call the telephone number in the contract. If I cancel for now, will the current entries no longer be retained?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will call the contract's number, and ask whether the entries remain after cancellation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 画面の注意書きを確認してから取り消しましょう。必要な情報は請求書にありますので、確認後に入力し直せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's read the on-screen notes before cancelling. The necessary details are on the invoice, so you can enter them again after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日はここで中止します。名義が違う理由を確かめてから、手数料も含めてやり直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は中止し名義の理由と手数料を確認後にやり直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll stop here for today. After confirming why the name differs, I'll start over, including checking the fee.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will stop today and start over after checking the reason for the account name and the fee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 実行前に気づかれてよかったです。名義の確認後にまたお困りでしたらお声がけください。それでは、契約書も忘れずにお持ちになって、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: It's good you noticed before executing it. If you need help again after confirming the name, let us know. Don't forget to take your contract with you, and take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品でお会計ですね。袋はお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're checking out with these items. Do you have a bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さい袋を一つ持っていますが、洗剤まで入れると食品がつぶれそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 袋が小さく洗剤を入れると食品がつぶれそうと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have one small bag, but if I put the detergent in too, the food may get crushed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the bag is small and the detergent could crush the food. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 洗剤を別にされますか。有料の袋もありますので、必要でしたら料金表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Would you like to separate the detergent? We also sell bags; please check the price display if you need one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 洗剤用に一枚買います。食品は持ってきた袋へ自分で入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 洗剤用に一枚購入し食品は持参袋へ自分で入れると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll buy one for the detergent. I'll put the food into my own bag myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will buy one bag for the detergent and put the food into your own bag yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一枚追加しますね。お支払いはどの方法になさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll add one bag. How would you like to pay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: スマートフォンで払いたいのですが、電池が切れそうです。このカードも使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電池が少ないためカードも使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to pay with my phone, but its battery is almost flat. Can I use this card too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can use the card too because your battery is low. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: カードの種類を確認します。こちらの表示にある種類ですね。今回はカードでお支払いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check the type of card. It's one of the types shown here. Will you pay by card this time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、カードにします。暗証番号を入力する必要があれば、画面を確認してから操作します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カードに変更し必要なら画面を確認して暗証番号を入力すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I'll use the card. If I need to enter a PIN, I'll check the screen before doing so.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will switch to the card and, if needed, check the screen before entering the PIN. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では端末の案内に沿ってお願いします。決済が終わるまでカードをお取りにならず、表示をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please follow the terminal's instructions. Do not take the card before payment is finished; wait for the display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 完了と出ました。レシートを受け取ってから、洗剤と食品を分けて袋に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 完了表示を確認しレシート受領後に洗剤と食品を分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: It says completed. After receiving the receipt, I'll bag the detergent and food separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you confirmed the completed display and will separate the detergent and food after receiving the receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらがレシートと追加の袋です。カードもお忘れなく、分けたお荷物を気をつけてお持ち帰りください。またのお買い物をお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are your receipt and the extra bag. Don't forget your card, and take care carrying your separate bags home. We look forward to seeing you again.
